messages.subject: jQuery does not change element with 'active' class when element is clicked
parts:

jquery.min.js:2 Uncaught Error: Syntax error, unrecognized expression: https://xxxxxxxx.shinyapps.io/jeremy-test/#dashboard2

    at n.fn.init.find (jquery.min.js:2)
    at n.fn.init (jquery.min.js:2)

Jeremy
